$Comment: What Martha packs for a player each time their favor with her climbs another step past Head of the
Table: the Beyond block in ZiggfreedCommon/Reputations/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast_Host.json names
this table, and its Every is the size of a step. Every roll is read on its own: the first always pays
and plays the moment Harvest_Feast_Feast_Basket (a toast and a sound), so the basket never lands
unannounced; the second is a chance on top. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100. Festival tokens and
Harvest Coins pay through the Currency reward kind, since a counter wallet has no item to hand over.
Text names the reward on Martha's Reputation page and in the notice that pays it (Feast Basket instead
of Loot Bundle) and gives its hover a line; the hover then lists what this table pays.
Name: Harvest_Feast_Feast_Basket
